Name: ListQuotes
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: ListQuotes, command: many)
SELECT
  p.id,
  p.description,
  p.quote_date,
  c.company_name AS customer_name
FROM
  quotes p
JOIN
  customers c ON p.customer_id = c.id
WHERE
  p.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY
  date(p.quote_date) DESC,
  p.id DESC
LIMIT ? OFFSET ?;
Template:
SELECT
  ⟨c0:p.id⟩,
  ⟨c1:p.description⟩,
  ⟨c2:p.quote_date⟩,
  ⟨c3 aliased:c.company_name⟩ AS customer_name
FROM
  quotes p
JOIN
  customers c ON p.customer_id = c.id
WHERE
  p.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY
  date(p.quote_date) DESC,
  p.id DESC
LIMIT ⟨p0⟩ OFFSET ⟨p1⟩;⟨arguments p0 p1⟩

Name: WindowOrdering
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: WindowOrdering, command: many)
SELECT id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY lower(category) ORDER BY date(quote_date) DESC, id) AS position,
  sum(price) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running
FROM quotes ORDER BY position, date(quote_date);
Template: SELECT ⟨c0:id⟩, ⟨c1 aliased:row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY lower(category) ORDER BY date(quote_date) DESC, id)⟩ AS position,\n  ⟨c2 aliased:sum(price) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)⟩ AS running\nFROM quotes ORDER BY position, date(quote_date);

FROM (SELECT id, category, quote_date FROM quotes ORDER BY date(quote_date) DESC LIMIT 100) recent
WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM quotes ORDER BY lower(description) LIMIT ?)
ORDER BY date(recent.quote_date), id;

Name: UpsertQuote
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: UpsertQuote, command: exec)
INSERT INTO quotes (id, description, category, price, quote_date, customer_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET description = excluded.description || ' (' || date('now') || ')', price = max(quotes.price, excluded.price)
WHERE quotes.price < excluded.price;
